design.hypothesis: Does correction timing improve edit/subject/pattern joint success at equal integrated correction RMS?
design.primary: BUDGET_EARLY vs C50 vs BUDGET_LATE; task and seed paired
design.schedules: a_i=h_i*r_i; mu=sum(a_i*q_i)/sum(a_i); s=.5/max(mu,1-mu); lambda_i=.5 +/- s*(q_i-mu). q_i=sigma midpoint; r_i=R72 C50 applied RMS/.5.
design.outputs: Each image saves 384px preview, native pattern crop, scalar logs, sheets and results ZIP immediately.
design.kv_blocks: single_transformer_blocks 1..26; paired K/V; first 7 steps; gate=1; no spatial gating
design.runtime: Existing pinned offline environment. 84 standalone NFE/image; inversion cache amortization reported separately.

preregistration.primary: Joint success: edit_ok=1, subject_ok=1, pattern_ok=1, artifact=0. All planned jobs remain in denominator; unjudged rates pending.
preregistration.budget: Report measured sum(h_i*RMS(applied correction)) and relative deviation from target. Matching tolerance 1%; mismatched runs reported separately.
preregistration.comparison: Compare all 8 matched task/seed pairs. Report per-task results and signed joint-success changes, not only pooled NCC. Pattern NCC is secondary.
preregistration.decision: Adopt one common schedule only if it gains >=2 joint successes out of 8 vs C50, with no greater major-artifact count and no task losing both seeds. Otherwise retain the observed trade-off and close this timing hypothesis.
preregistration.closure: Final development round; archive both outcomes. No adaptive extra arms. Independent-object and external-method comparisons remain writing-handoff items.
preregistration.evaluation: Offline human review includes the 16 new images and 40 embedded references. No API/VLM required. Ratings remain pending until entered.
